# Roadmap

This page lists the open version milestones. The table between the markers is generated from GitHub by
tools/ci/roadmap_render.py; the daily Roadmap refresh workflow proposes a bot pull request when a count moves. Issue lists and their blocking order live on GitHub only: open a milestone to see its
issues in the [milestone list](https://github.com/lusoris/SnatchArr/milestones).

## Milestones

<!-- markdownlint-disable MD013 -->
<!-- roadmap:begin (generated by tools/ci/roadmap_render.py --write; do not edit) -->
| Milestone | Scope | Open issues |
| :--- | :--- | ---: |
| [0.9](https://github.com/lusoris/SnatchArr/milestone/14) | First optional modules and the LLM access module: request portal, adult content module, LLM integration. Epics: #570, #571. Roadmap: docs/roadmap.md. | 125 |
| [0.10](https://github.com/lusoris/SnatchArr/milestone/15) | Adult module: identity, Stash, image sets, matching, adult requests. | 29 |
| [0.11](https://github.com/lusoris/SnatchArr/milestone/16) | LLM integration: skills bundle, MCP server, llms.txt, connect guides. | 5 |
| [0.12](https://github.com/lusoris/SnatchArr/milestone/17) | Jellyfin companion plugin and every function surface inside Jellyfin. | 27 |
| [0.13](https://github.com/lusoris/SnatchArr/milestone/18) | Rule-driven library processing (ADR-0041): rules, lossless remux, audio, staging and safety, VMAFx encode-job client, cutoff guard, UI. | 8 |
| [0.14](https://github.com/lusoris/SnatchArr/milestone/19) | VMAFx toolkit in SnatchArr: the VMAFx surfaces after auto encode (scoring, compare, ladder, per-shot tuning, saliency, HDR, sample clips, node workers), each called through VMAFx, never re-implemented. | 1 |
| [0.15](https://github.com/lusoris/SnatchArr/milestone/20) | List sync across instances (ADR-0047): import-list definitions and exclusions kept alike on every instance of one app, blocklisted releases spread through the queue, and state written back to source lists, each observe first. | 9 |
| [Metadata: video](https://github.com/lusoris/SnatchArr/milestone/21) | Film and series metadata providers from goenvoy metadata/video: foreign titles, ID mapping, request artwork. Ranked by consumer value. | 6 |
| [Metadata: anime](https://github.com/lusoris/SnatchArr/milestone/22) | Anime metadata providers from goenvoy metadata/anime: title synonyms for anime foreign-title search and ID mapping. Ranked by consumer value. | 4 |
| [Metadata: book](https://github.com/lusoris/SnatchArr/milestone/23) | Book metadata providers from goenvoy metadata/book: external IDs for Readarr-fork request join keys. Ranked by consumer value. | 2 |
| [Metadata: music](https://github.com/lusoris/SnatchArr/milestone/24) | Music metadata providers from goenvoy metadata/music: MusicBrainz IDs, listening state, artwork. Ranked by consumer value. | 6 |
| [Metadata: game](https://github.com/lusoris/SnatchArr/milestone/25) | Game metadata providers from goenvoy metadata/game. No consumer yet: SnatchArr manages no game library (open product question in each issue). | 9 |
| [Metadata: tracking](https://github.com/lusoris/SnatchArr/milestone/26) | Tracking providers from goenvoy metadata/tracking: watched state for watch-aware modes and list-sync sources. Ranked by consumer value. | 4 |
| [Metadata: adult](https://github.com/lusoris/SnatchArr/milestone/27) | Adult metadata providers from goenvoy metadata/adult: stash-box and ThePornDB for the adult module. Ranked by consumer value. | 2 |
| [Metadata: infrastructure](https://github.com/lusoris/SnatchArr/milestone/28) | Cross-cutting metadata infrastructure: shared outbound cache and per-provider rate limit (golusoris transport), metadata proxy deployable, call measurement. | 3 |

## Watch-aware modes

Until the watch-aware remove-when-seen mode ships, [Maintainerr](https://github.com/Maintainerr/Maintainerr)
removes watched media.
